an10.114:1.1: adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca
an10.114:1.3: adhammañca viditvā dhammañca anatthañca viditvā atthañca yathā dhammo yathā attho tathā paṭipajjitabbaṃ
an10.114:2.1: katamo ca bhikkhave adhammo katamo ca dhammo katamo ca anattho katamo ca attho
an10.114:3.3: ye ca micchādiṭṭhipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti ayaṃ anattho
an10.114:3.4: sammādiṭṭhipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti ayaṃ attho.

an10.114:8.4: sammāvāyāmapaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti ayaṃ attho.

an10.114:13.1: adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca
an10.114:13.3: adhammañca viditvā dhammañca anatthañca viditvā atthañca yathā dhammo yathā attho tathā paṭipajjitabbanti
an10.114:13.4: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttanti.
